description: This file defines the implementation of the VSSPath class, which handles conversion and manipulation of VSS paths between different formats (VSS, VSSGen1, JSON). It includes methods for parsing, converting, and generating path representations, and is part of a larger project related to path handling in a system that uses VSS paths.

classes.name: VSSPath
classes.description: A class for managing and converting VSS path formats, including generating JSON paths and converting between VSS, VSSGen1, and VSSGen2 formats.

methods.name: VSSPath
methods.description: Constructor initializing VSSPath object with given paths and origin flag.

methods.name: isGen1Origin
methods.description: Checks if the path is from a VSSGen1 origin.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns the path as a string, depending on the origin.

methods.name: fromVSS
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a VSS string, determining format and generating related paths.

methods.name: gen1togen2
methods.description: Converts a VSSGen1 path to VSSGen2 format.

methods.name: gen2togen1
methods.description: Converts a VSSGen2 path to VSSGen1 format.

methods.name: gen2tojson
methods.description: Converts a VSSGen2 path to a JSON path string.

methods.name: jsontogen2
methods.description: Converts a JSON path string back to VSSGen2 format.

methods.name: fromVSSGen2
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a VSSGen2 path.

methods.name: fromVSSGen1
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a VSSGen1 path.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a JSON path string, specifying if it's from VSSGen1.
